one_line: Early modern king of Manipur who forged Shan alliances, patronised Vishnu worship at Bishnupur, and anchored Manipur’s dated royal chronicle with the Cheithaba system.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but athletic build, average height, with the poised bearing of a seasoned yet still vigorous ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, light brown-medium complexion, straight nose, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with a slight upward tilt, neatly groomed moustache and short goatee, default expression calm and alert with a hint of analytical focus.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and drawn back into a compact topknot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow deep-red cloth band; sides neatly smoothed, no loose strands over the forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate Meitei royal attire: a long-sleeved off-white cotton kurta-like tunic reaching mid-thigh with a subtle woven border at cuffs, over which he wears a fitted sleeveless deep-indigo cotton jacket with a narrow standing collar and simple geometric border in muted gold; lower body in a tightly wrapped white dhoti-style garment pleated in front and ending just above the ankles, edged with a thin red stripe; a pale-cream cotton phanek-style wrap sash worn diagonally from left shoulder to right hip, subtly patterned with fine horizontal stripes, evoking ceremonial drape; simple brown leather sandals; jewellery kept dignified—a single thin gold torque-style necklace, small gold ear studs, and a plain gold armlet on the right arm, plus a narrow cloth belt in dark maroon securing the waist.
appearance.signature: A sheathed medium-length straight sword with a slightly flared tip, plain steel guard and wooden hilt wrapped in dark-brown cord, carried at his left hip in a dark teak-brown wooden scabbard with minimal brass fittings, symbolising both martial authority and alliance warfare.

ref_desc: Meidingu Senbi Kiyamba is a lean mid-30s Meitei king with an oval light-brown face, almond eyes, black hair in a compact topknot wrapped in a deep-red band, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-indigo sleeveless jacket, white dhoti, diagonal cream sash, simple gold jewellery, and a dark-brown sheathed straight sword at his left hip with accents of maroon and muted gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Meidingu Senbi Kiyamba: a mid-30s lean Meitei king with an oval light-brown face, high cheekbones, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes, a neat moustache and short goatee, and thick black hair pulled into a compact topknot wrapped with a deep-red cloth band. Show him from head to toe in era-accurate 15th-century Manipur royal attire: a long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic to mid-thigh with subtle woven borders at the cuffs, a fitted sleeveless deep-indigo cotton jacket with a narrow standing collar and simple muted-gold geometric edging, and a tightly wrapped white dhoti-like lower garment pleated in front, ankle length, with a thin red border. Add a pale-cream cotton phanek-style sash worn diagonally from left shoulder to right hip with fine horizontal stripe texture, a dark maroon cloth belt at the waist, and simple brown leather sandals. Include restrained jewellery: a thin gold torque necklace, small gold ear studs, and a plain gold armlet on his right arm. At his left hip, show his signature medium-length straight sword with a slightly flared tip in a dark teak-brown wooden scabbard with minimal brass fittings and a wooden hilt wrapped in dark-brown cord. Use a palette dominated by off-white, deep indigo, maroon, muted gold, and dark brown, and keep his expression calm and alert, suggesting a strategic, dignified ruler ready for both court and campaign.
